column1: # 1.21.1 -> 1.21.11 renames, applied by scripts/port/gen.py to the generated source tree.
# Format: `old<TAB>new`. Applied to every text file as a whole-word replacement, string literals
# included, because a mixin target such as @Inject(method = "getServer") names a method in a
# string. Only add a pair when the old name cannot mean anything else in this repository.
# Rows with a package path come first (the generator sorts longest-first): the import line has to
# move to the new package, and the simple name is then fixed by the short row below it.
# Derived from the Loom mappings of both versions, joined on the intermediary name, and filtered to
# the names this source tree actually uses. Regenerate the candidate list with scripts/port/candidates.py if a
# future error looks like a rename that is missing here.
